production.provenance: Build ID verified in eight actual successful HTML responses, with retained raw HTML bytes and SHA-256; it is not inferred from the disk BUILD_ID alone.

scope.description: Public local duels, explicit source recipe, real pressure costs, public commands/taunts and genuine outcomes. Canvas and DOM observers are passive. Seven new BODY actions, ten safe presentations; painted-partner throws/finishers and entity specials remain studies. Historical V11/V12 and supplied costumes are independently excluded.
scope.inheritedNormalValidation: These18 inherited normals are not exhaustively replayed by the V105 browser recipe; their own V104 native tests and browser recipe remain separate.
scope.openCountMeaning: 17 rows have no source-recipe binding. A linked row is not a full-kit completion certificate: the separate inventory, entity, campaign and appearance requirements listed below can remain open.
scope.interaction: Fresh public local-versus selection, explicit opt-in, keyboard walking/attacks, real pressure-earned costs, accessible command/taunt buttons and genuine round/match outcomes. No actor, campaign, action, source registry, or input binding injection.
limitations: Desktop keyboard and public pointer commands only; this recipe does not certify mobile or physical controllers.
Four painted-mannequin throw studies and six partner finisher/clemency studies remain outside the new duel animation bank.
Entity specials, complete supers, persistent equipment/lost weapons, campaign sequences and costume animation requirements remain separately open.
Scar S4 is a frontal contact counter; projectile reflection is not claimed.

Browser journeys verify native cycles and public activation. Exact meter debits, insufficient-meter rejection and an actual S4 riposte are validated by the separate engine tests, rather than asserted by these screenshot journeys.
Existing native drawings are reused unchanged. Source/runtime proof and screenshot inspection do not certify full kit completion or 1:1 canon fidelity.
